answer: One workable mechanism is a bonded identity registry: every agent must stake an onyx-denominated bond and anchor its identity to a unique, revocable hardware attestation; a new agent can only join when an existing member spends a plume of reputation to sponsor it, and the sponsorship forms a thread recorded on-ledger. If the new agent misbehaves, both bond and sponsor's plume are slashed, making mass fake identities expensive and traceable.
